title: 2025 Accessible Housing Special Zone – Ministry of Interior Real Estate Information Platform
summary: The Ministry of Interior's Real Estate Information Platform has launched a special zone for 2025 showcasing accessible housing options, providing listings and information for people with disabilities seeking barrier-free homes.
sourceName: 內政部不動產資訊平台

relatedSources.name: 內政部不動產資訊平台

body:
The Ministry of Interior's Real Estate Information Platform has launched a special zone for 2025 showcasing accessible housing options, providing listings and information for people with disabilities seeking barrier-free homes.

Read more from the original source: [內政部不動產資訊平台](https://pip.moi.gov.tw/V3/J/SCRJ0102.aspx?k=B3&g=B3M2&p=27)
